tools.description: List the account's past generation tasks, newest first, with pagination. tools.description: Estimate the cost of a task without creating it or charging the account. Pass the model and the full input payload.

tools.description: Return the account's current balance in USD. Takes no parameters.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_audio, upload_file, get_task, list_tasks · Private data: upload_file · Public sink: upload_file, get_task · Destructive: dry_run_cost.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_audio, upload_file, get_task, list_tasks · Private data: upload_file · Public sink: upload_file, get_task · Destructive: dry_run_cost

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
